app_summary.title: FremontApp requests summary
app_summary.description: Service requests created, closed and open and average days to close for Jul 1–Sep 30, 2026 (the dashboard's default range), from the city's FremontApp dashboard.

app_top.title: Top FremontApp requests
app_top.description: Ten most common FremontApp request types, Jul 1–Sep 30, 2026, from the city's FremontApp dashboard.

asian_groups.title: Asian communities
asian_groups.description: Share of Fremont residents by Asian group (alone), ACS 2020–2024 table DP05. Read Oct 24, 2026.

bart_history.title: BART weekday exits
bart_history.description: Average weekday exits at Fremont and Warm Springs stations, FY 2019, 2024 and 2025, averaged from BART daily station exits (DataSF). Read Oct 24, 2026.

business.title: Shopping and dining
business.description: Restaurant and retail counts, jobs, taxable sales and major centers, from Census County Business Patterns, CDTFA and the City of Fremont. Read Oct 24, 2026.

census_population.title: Census counts and estimate
census_population.description: Decennial Census counts for Fremont 1960–2020 (1960–2000 as compiled by MTC in 2021) and the Census Bureau's Vintage 2025 estimate for Jul 1, 2025 from QuickFacts. Read Oct 24, 2026.

census_profile.title: Census QuickFacts profile
census_profile.description: Fremont city profile from Census QuickFacts: mostly ACS 2020–2024 5-year survey estimates, with age and race from Census population estimates. Read Oct 24, 2026.

city_facts.title: City services and budget
city_facts.description: FY 2026–27 budget (proposed general fund $289.1M plus about $138M other funds, about $427M in all; adopted Jun 9, 2026), police calls for service, and Fremont Unified enrollment. From news reports and agency pages, read Oct 24, 2026.

city_parks.title: City parks list
city_parks.description: City of Fremont parks by name, type, status and acreage, from the city's park inventory. Read Oct 24, 2026.

city_rankings.title: City rankings
city_rankings.description: Fremont's rank in 2025–26 national city rankings, read from each WalletHub ranking table (and Trust for Public Land ParkScore) on Oct 24, 2026, with category ranks and publication dates.

civic_facts.title: Voters and city facts
civic_facts.description: Nov 2024 turnout (Alameda County ROV), May 2026 registration by party (CA Secretary of State), affordable units, city FTEs and credit rating (City of Fremont). Read Oct 24, 2026.

climate_kpis.title: Climate indicators
climate_kpis.description: EVs registered, trees planted and pounds of food recovered in 2025, from the city's Climate Action dashboard.

climate_normals.title: Weather by month
climate_normals.description: NOAA 1991–2020 climate normals for the Fremont station: average high, low and rainfall by month. Read Oct 24, 2026.

commute_modes.title: How Fremont gets to work
commute_modes.description: Census ACS 2020–2024 table DP03: workers 16+ by way of getting to work. Read Oct 24, 2026.

crime_clearance.title: Crime clearances
crime_clearance.description: Violent and property crimes reported and cleared: Fremont 2015–2025 and California 2020–2025. California DOJ Crimes and Clearances (July 2026 release). Read Oct 24, 2026.

crime_oj.title: Reported crime by city
crime_oj.description: Violent and property crimes by type and year, 2015–2025, for Fremont. California DOJ OpenJustice, Crimes and Clearances file (published July 2026). 2025 is incomplete for Fremont.

dof_population.title: DOF population estimates
dof_population.description: California Department of Finance E-1 estimates for Fremont, Jan 1 2025 (revised) and Jan 1 2026 (provisional). Checked Oct 24, 2026 against DOF's own E-1 2026 press release (May 1, 2026).

ev_permits.title: EV charger permits
ev_permits.description: Electric vehicle charger permits issued in Fremont per year, 2021–2026 (2026 year to date), from the city's Climate Action dashboard.

ev_zip.title: Vehicles by fuel and ZIP
ev_zip.description: Light-duty registrations by fuel type for Fremont ZIPs 94536, 94538, 94539, 94555, as of Jan 1, 2020 and Dec 31, 2025. California DMV via data.ca.gov. Read Oct 24, 2026.

family_costs.title: Child care and utilities
family_costs.description: Alameda County child care costs (2022) and licensed spaces (2023) from kidsdata.org; electricity rate and bill (Ava/PG&E, Mar 2026); ACWD water use per person (FY 2023–24). Read Oct 24, 2026.

fire_incidents.title: Fire incidents by year
fire_incidents.description: Fremont Fire Department incidents per year, 2021–2025, read from the city's Power BI dashboard (refreshed Oct 23, 2026). The 2026 figure is left out because its date range could not be confirmed.

fire_summary.title: Fire department summary
fire_summary.description: Full-year 2025 incident total from the city's incident-summaries page, plus stations and area covered from the city's Fremont Fire dashboard (refreshed Oct 23, 2026).

fire_types.title: Fire incidents by type, 2025
fire_types.description: Fremont Fire Department incidents in 2025 by type (19,003 in all), from the incident-summaries page on fremont.gov. Replaces an earlier top-five table from the Power BI dashboard whose date range could not be confirmed. Read Oct 25, 2026.

ghg_sector.title: Emissions by sector
ghg_sector.description: Community greenhouse gas emissions (metric tons CO2e) by sector for inventory years 2005, 2010, 2015 and 2018, and the city's 2030 goal, read from the chart data on the city's Climate Action dashboard.

hate_crimes.title: Hate crimes, Fremont
hate_crimes.description: Hate crime incidents by year closed, Fremont PD, 2015–2025. California DOJ Hate Crimes file. Read Oct 24, 2026.

health_places.title: Adult health (CDC PLACES)
health_places.description: Modeled adult health prevalence for Fremont with 95% ranges, CDC PLACES 2025 release (mostly 2023 data). Read Oct 24, 2026.

high_schools.title: High school rankings
high_schools.description: Fremont Unified's five comprehensive high schools: U.S. News Best High Schools 2026–27 ranks and stats (prior-year ranks from FUSD's Aug 2025 release), plus CAASPP 2025–26 grade 11 results with district and state benchmarks. Read Oct 24, 2026.

highway_aadt.title: Highway traffic volumes
highway_aadt.description: Caltrans 2024 annual average daily traffic at selected count points on highways through Fremont. Read Oct 24, 2026.

homeless_monthly.title: Homeless response by month
homeless_monthly.description: Monthly cleanups, encampments fully cleared, outreach visits and FremontApp homeless-related reports, Jul 2025–Sep 2026, from the city's Homeless Response dashboard. The dashboard's headline app-report count (715) exceeds the sum of these rows (687).

homeless_pit.title: Point-in-time counts
homeless_pit.description: Unhoused residents in Fremont from point-in-time counts, 2017–2026, as shown on the city's Homeless Response dashboard.

housing_production.title: Housing permits and target
housing_production.description: Units permitted in 2025 and progress toward Fremont's 2023–2031 RHNA target, from the city's 2025 Annual Progress Report staff report (Planning Commission, Feb 26, 2026). Self-reported by the city; HCD does not verify it.

languages.title: Languages at home
languages.description: Language spoken at home, residents 5 and older, ACS 2020–2024 table C16001. Read Oct 24, 2026.

living_facts.title: Costs, transit and services
living_facts.description: Utility bills, tax rates, transit ridership, hospitals, voters, energy and hazards, each from the agency named in its row. Read Oct 24, 2026.

ots_rankings.title: OTS crash rankings
ots_rankings.description: California Office of Traffic Safety 2023 crash rankings for Fremont among 62 cities of 100,001–250,000 people (1 = worst). Read Oct 24, 2026.

parks_summary.title: Parks and facilities
parks_summary.description: City park counts and acreage, Trust for Public Land ParkScore, libraries and community centers. Read Oct 24, 2026.

pavement.title: Pavement condition
pavement.description: MTC Pavement Condition Index (three-year moving average) 2022–2024 for Fremont and the Bay Area, Jan 2026 update. Read Oct 24, 2026.

people_more.title: More resident facts
people_more.description: ACS 2020–2024 measures (age, households, income, housing stock, cost burden, veterans, disability) and County Business Patterns 2023 jobs. Read Oct 24, 2026.

police_facts.title: Police and survey facts
police_facts.description: Fremont PD calls for service, staffing and 911 answer times, plus the City's 2025 Community Survey safety results. Each row names its source. Read Oct 24, 2026.

police_staffing.title: Police staffing
police_staffing.description: Funded sworn and civilian positions for Fremont, 2015–2025. California DOJ Law Enforcement Personnel file. Read Oct 24, 2026.

redfin_market.title: Redfin market snapshot
redfin_market.description: Redfin housing market pages for Fremont city (Sep 2026) and ZIP codes 94536, 94538, 94539 and 94555 (Aug 2026), read Oct 24, 2026. Redfin's terms for republishing these figures are not yet confirmed.

regional_parks.title: Regional parks in Fremont
regional_parks.description: East Bay Regional Park District parks in Fremont with acreage, from EBRPD park pages and news releases. Read Oct 24, 2026.

rent_by_bedroom.title: Rent by bedroom
rent_by_bedroom.description: Census ACS median gross rent by bedrooms (2015–2019 and 2020–2024; capped at $3,500) and HUD Fair Market Rents FY2025–26 for the Oakland-Fremont area. Read Oct 24, 2026.

resident_industries.title: Residents' industries
resident_industries.description: Employed residents 16+ by industry, top seven, ACS 2020–2024 table C24050. Read Oct 24, 2026.

retail_mix.title: Stores by type
retail_mix.description: Retail establishments in Fremont by category (437 stores in all), 2022 Economic Census, retail trade, Fremont city. The total matches the 2022 Economic Census retail store count. Read Oct 24, 2026.

rhna_by_income.title: Housing target by income
rhna_by_income.description: RHNA target, units permitted 2023–2025, units remaining, and 2025 permits by income level, from the city's 2025 Annual Progress Report staff report. ADUs are assigned to income levels using ABAG affordability assumptions.

school_list.title: School finder data
school_list.description: Every Fremont Unified elementary, middle and high school: CAASPP 2025–26 and 2024–25 results, DataQuest 2025–26 enrollment, Ed-Data 2024–25 chronic absence and suspension, 2025–26 low-income share, and U.S. News ranks. Read Oct 24, 2026.

school_trends.title: District trends
school_trends.description: Fremont Unified by school year with state comparisons: enrollment, graduation, UC/CSU readiness, dropout, chronic absence, suspension, spending, teacher salary, staffing. CDE data via Ed-Data. Read Oct 24, 2026.

schools.title: Fremont Unified schools
schools.description: Fremont Unified counts, enrollment, CAASPP 2025–26 results, four-year graduation rate (class of 2025) and staffing, from CDE (via Ed-Data), CAASPP and FUSD. Read Oct 24, 2026.

source_list.title: Source pages
source_list.description: Every page used for a figure on this dashboard, with publisher and what it supports. Read Oct 24, 2026.

traffic_facts.title: Streets and traffic facts
traffic_facts.description: Street network facts from the City of Fremont, Fremont PD and MTC, fatal-crash victim shares, and the 2025 Community Survey traffic results. Each row names its source. Read Oct 24, 2026.

traffic_fatal.title: Fatal crashes by year
traffic_fatal.description: Fatal crashes on Fremont city streets, 2014–2025, plus crashes the city lists separately as others. City of Fremont Safety Data and Trends. Read Oct 24, 2026.

vacancy.title: Commercial vacancy
vacancy.description: Office, R&D and industrial vacancy for the Fremont submarkets, Kidder Mathews 3Q 2026 reports. Read Oct 24, 2026.

zillow_history.title: Zillow history
zillow_history.description: Monthly Zillow Home Value Index and Observed Rent Index for Fremont city, Jan 2015 to Sep 2026, from Zillow Research city-level files. Read Oct 24, 2026.

zillow_market.title: Zillow home value and rent
zillow_market.description: Zillow Research figures for Fremont from Zillow's city home values page (data through Sep 30, 2026; sales measures through Aug 31), read Oct 24, 2026. Zillow requires clear attribution.

utilities.title: Gas and internet
utilities.description: PG&E residential gas rate and average bill, Ava vs PG&E rate difference, internet providers, coverage and advertised prices for Fremont. Read Oct 24, 2026.

events.title: Events and recreation
events.description: Signature annual events, Mission Peak, the 2022 Parks & Recreation Master Plan inventory, pickleball, dog parks, Aqua Adventure, recreation registrants and facilities. Read Oct 24, 2026.

startups.title: Startup ecosystem
startups.description: Company counts from Crunchbase and VCBacked.co (crowdsourced directories), unicorns and IPOs, the City of Fremont's own claims on tech and manufacturing firms, patent holders, Warm Springs Innovation District and rankings. Read Oct 24, 2026.

startup_rounds.title: Largest funding rounds
startup_rounds.description: Largest recent funding rounds and IPOs by Fremont-linked companies, 2022–2026 (some have contested or dual headquarters, noted in each row), each row citing its own source; not an exhaustive total. Read Oct 24, 2026.

food_prices.title: Food costs
food_prices.description: Grocery and restaurant price inflation (Bay Area CPI), MIT living-wage food costs for Alameda County, Fremont grocery and restaurant counts (2022 Economic Census), farmers' markets, CalFresh. Read Oct 24, 2026.

food_cpi.title: Food price inflation
food_cpi.description: Bay Area (SF–Oakland–Hayward) CPI for groceries, restaurants, all food and all items, each August 2018–2026, from BLS news releases. Read Oct 24, 2026.

health_access.title: Hospitals, coverage and providers
health_access.description: CMS Care Compare stars, Leapfrog safety grades, ER times and volumes for Washington Hospital and Kaiser Fremont; clinics; insurance coverage by type (ACS 2024) and Medi-Cal. Read Oct 24, 2026.

leapfrog_grades.title: Leapfrog safety grades
leapfrog_grades.description: Leapfrog Hospital Safety Grades for Washington Hospital and Kaiser Fremont, Spring 2023 to Spring 2026. Read Oct 24, 2026.

jobs_more.title: Unemployment, wages and jobs
jobs_more.description: Fremont city unemployment rate (BLS/EDD LAUS via YCharts), jobs located in Fremont vs employed residents (Housing Element/LEHD), city minimum wage, median earnings (ACS 2024), WARN layoffs, commute shares. Read Oct 24, 2026.

employers.title: Largest employers
employers.description: Fremont's ten largest employers from the City's FY2024 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report principal-employers table, as transcribed on Wikipedia; the FY2025 ACFR (Dec 2025) should be used to refresh. Read Oct 24, 2026.
